If you're building a Shiny app, we deploy and share it on shinyapps.io; if you're doing the report track, use this time to finalize your visualization and write-up. The rest of the week is studio time: peer feedback and dry-run presentations to get your project ready for the final session.

::: {.callout-note}
Building an app? [Styling Your App](/modules/module-6.1.qmd) and [Troubleshooting Your App](/modules/module-6.1.qmd) are optional reference material for polishing and debugging.
:::
